svg.text: Make it first, so every later module is checked by CI from day one.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Start an empty package with a version number, a license file and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Python 3.11 or later; list the four extras (PDF, drawings,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: media, release), each with its libraries.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Copy the folder layout of a finished repository into the template:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: docs, cad, bom, media, the license files and the citation file.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Write the stub: the version pin, the identity file, the agent rules

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and commands, and a copy of the standard. No code, no fonts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Write the CI workflow: check on every push and pull request with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the core install, on Linux, macOS and Windows through WSL2, on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Python 3.11 and the newest release; render and publish PDFs on

svg.text: Fits: the stub is the only kit content inside a repository (joint 6);

svg.text: the check job reads the checker's exit code (joint 2).
